title: HOW TO PLAY POWERBALL XS & OS

sections.text:
WHAT IS POWERBALL XS & OS?

Powerball Xs & Os is a draw game where the goal is to match your team logos with the winning team logos selected in the drawing.

Ticket Price: $5

Drawings: Sunday Evenings

HOW TO PURCHASE TICKETS

How to Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer. Powerball Xs & Os tickets cost $5 per game and are available for purchase* at the counter of Arizona Lottery retailers and at Arizona Lottery vending machines. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

How to Choose Your Team Logos

To let the computer select the team logos for you, choose a Quick Pick on the vending machine or tell the cashier you want a Quick Pick at the time of your purchase to let the computer select 8 team logos from a set of 32.

To choose your own 8 team logos from a set of 32, fill out a selection slip or tell the cashier which team logos you would like to select.

HOW TO CHECK THE WINNING RESULTS

You can find the winning team logos** online, or you can check your tickets by using a ticket scanner at an Arizona Lottery retailer or by calling the Winning Numbers Hotline:

Phoenix: 480.829.7425
Tucson: 520.325.9141
All Other Areas: 800.499.3798

Powerball Xs & Os results are randomly drawn and not based on, determined by, or dependent on the outcome of NFL games.

 

*Sales stop on draw nights at 8:59 p.m. Arizona time from the second Sunday in March through the first Saturday in November and at 9:59 pm Arizona time from the first Sunday in November through the second Saturday in March.

**Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

ABOUT WINNING

How to Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

Jackpot Payment Options

If you win the jackpot, you have 60 days to choose a payment option:

30-year annuity
Lump-sum cash - which will be approximately half the amount of the announced jackpot

If you do not select cash or annuity within the 60 days, your prize will be paid as an annuity.

 

POWERBALL XS & OS FAQS

What are the odds of winning Powerball Xs & Os?

The overall odds of winning a cash prize are approximately 1 in 12.16.

When are Powerball Xs & Os drawings held?

Drawings are held Sunday evenings.

What does “Results Pending” mean in the “Next Estimated Jackpot” section?

When the website displays “Results Pending” for Powerball, Powerball Xs & Os, or Mega Millions draws, it means the Arizona Lottery is awaiting information from the Multi-State Lottery Association on if the jackpot has been increased or if anyone has won the jackpot. Once the Arizona Lottery receives this information, the next estimated jackpot amount will be displayed.

How often can I play my selected team logos?

You can play your selected team logos for up to 10 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or mark the corresponding circle indicating the number of draws you wish to play at the bottom of your selection slip.

How long do I have to claim a Powerball Xs & Os prize?

You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim a prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

What happens if multiple people win the jackpot?

If other tickets also match all eight teams, the prize pool will be split into equal amounts among all winning tickets. Lower-tier prizes may become pari-mutuel in some circumstances.
